title: Locker Rental: physical locker specifications by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Locker Rental product line. It states, for each of the six Locker Rental tiers, the locking mechanism used, the interior storage volume, whether the locker is climate-controlled, whether a towel hook is included, which bank of lockers the tier is assigned from, and whether the member may choose a preferred locker location within that bank.

## Physical specification table
| Tier | Locking mechanism | Interior volume | Climate-controlled | Towel hook included | Locker bank | Preferred-location choice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Small Locker | Combination lock | 1.5 cubic feet | No | No | Standard bank | No |
| Medium Locker | Combination lock | 3.0 cubic feet | No | Yes | Standard bank | No |
| Large Locker | Key lock | 5.0 cubic feet | No | Yes | Standard bank | No |
| Premium Climate-Controlled Locker | Electronic keypad lock | 5.0 cubic feet | Yes | Yes | Standard bank | No |
| Day-Use Locker | Combination lock | 1.5 cubic feet | No | No | Standard bank | No |
| VIP Locker Suite | Electronic keypad lock | 8.0 cubic feet | Yes | Yes | Premium row | Yes |

## Equivalent restatement (by question)
- Which tiers use an electronic keypad lock? The Premium Climate-Controlled Locker and the VIP Locker Suite.
- Which tier is the only one assigned from the premium row of lockers? The VIP Locker Suite.
- Is the Small Locker climate-controlled? No.
- Which tier offers the member a choice of preferred locker location? Only the VIP Locker Suite.
